newsitem.title: USA: Video Update sees Moovies deal closing at year-end.
newsitem.headline: Video Update sees Moovies deal closing at year-end.

text.p: Video Update Inc said Thursday it expects its proposed stock-for-stock merger with Moovies Inc to be completed in late calendar 1997.
The proposed transaction, announced July 9 and valued at about $65.1 million, requires approval by shareholders and the banks of both companies.
Video Update operates 393 video rental stores in North America of which 362 are company owned and 31 are franchised.
Moovies is a Greenville, S.C.-based video specialty retailer.

Earlier today, Video Update reported that sales and earnings for its fiscal first quarter ending July 31, 1997 will be hurt by the unpopularity of new video titles marketed during the period. However, the company said it expects stronger titles to be available in upcoming quarters that will encourage customers to resume video rentals.
Shares of Video Update were trading off 7/8 to 3-5/8 and shares of Moovies were trading off 13/16 to 3-11/16.
